text.formatted: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gladiator hits with it (included in the attack).

text.formatted: The gladiator makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

text.formatted: _Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

text.formatted: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
